rationale: McpClientOptions is the Go struct ClientOptions; Go flattens name/title/version into the embedded Implementation and splits roots into Roots and RootsFunc.
async: An awaited Promise is a blocking Go call that returns the value or error; a rejection is the returned error.

capabilities.rationale: ClientOptions.Capabilities; nil is undefined; initialize sends it and adds the roots capability when roots are configured.

name.rationale: Name of the Implementation embedded in ClientOptions.

title.rationale: Title of the embedded Implementation; empty is undefined.

protocolVersion.rationale: ClientOptions.ProtocolVersion holds one of the supported version literals; empty is undefined and sends the latest.

requestTimeoutMs.rationale: ClientOptions.RequestTimeoutMs; zero is undefined (default 30000) and a negative value disables the timeout, a Go mechanic noted at the field.

roots.rationale: The list or function union is the pair Roots and RootsFunc; RootsFunc returns (roots, error) for the Promise and its rejection.

async: AbortSignal is the context.Context passed to the request (Client.Request, CallTool, ...); cancelling it fails the request. No detached goroutine.
rationale: McpRequestOptions is the Go struct RequestOptions plus the ctx argument for signal; OnIssued is an extra Go field for request ordering.

signal.rationale: The context.Context argument of Client.Request and the methods built on it.
